t: 维西哥斯国王埃尔维希发起一个理事会,他在其中对西班牙的犹太人实施多种措施.
te: King Erwig of the Visigoths initiates a council in which he implements diverse measures against the Jews in Spain.
dz: 第十二届托莱多理事会:维西哥斯国王埃尔维希发起一个理事会,他在其中对西班牙的犹太人实施多种措施.
de: Twelfth Council of Toledo: King Erwig of the Visigoths initiates a council in which he implements diverse measures against the Jews in Spain.

t: 君士坦丁堡第三次议会废黜了安提奥克的保皇派马卡里乌斯一世.
te: The Third Council of Constantinople deposes patriarch Macarius I of Antioch.
dz: 君士坦丁堡第三次议会废黜了安提奥克的保皇派马卡里乌斯一世.
de: The Third Council of Constantinople deposes patriarch Macarius I of Antioch.

t: 教皇荣誉一世后来被第六届全基督教理事会驱逐.
te: Pope Honorius I is posthumously excommunicated by the Sixth Ecumenical Council.
dz: 教皇荣誉一世后来被第六届全基督教理事会驱逐.
de: Pope Honorius I is posthumously excommunicated by the Sixth Ecumenical Council.
